20.long_leg_note: a long straddle can lose at most its premium (the ask paid)
20.unbounded: a short straddle's loss grows without limit in the move; these are sized k-sigma moves, not bounds. The real-money form must be DEFINED-RISK: long straddles only, or every short straddle wrapped in long wings (an iron butterfly, max loss = wing width - credit).
